surface_request: Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.
plan:
SOURCE: The executable string and arguments list from the caller.
TRUST: Permitted executables are exactly /usr/bin/printf and /bin/echo.
SINK: Subprocess invocation with standard output captured as text.
GUARD: Raise ValueError if executable is not /usr/bin/printf or /bin/echo; pass arguments as a direct vector and keep shell processing disabled.
ORDER: Validate the executable against the allowlist before launching the subprocess, then capture and return its standard output.
EFFECT: Return the captured standard output text; allow process failures to propagate.
END_PLAN
